title: Wyndham Rewards Opens the Door to Extraordinary Escapes with Debut of Homes & Havens

***Members can now check in at hundreds of professionally managed homes, villas and other distinctive stays around the world, earning and redeeming points along the way***


**HIGHLIGHTS:**


- Wyndham Rewards is expanding with the debut of Homes & Havens℠, connecting members with a curated collection of professionally managed homes and distinctive stays around the world.
- Hundreds of homes and villas are available to book today, with even more unique accommodations—including cabins, tiny homes and yurts—expected in the coming months.
- Members earn 5 Wyndham Rewards points per dollar spent on qualified bookings with free night redemptions currently starting at 15,000 points per bedroom, per night.


PARSIPPANY, N.J.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Wyndham Rewards®](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards) is opening the door to a world of extraordinary escapes with the launch of[Homes & Havens SM](https://homesandhavens.com/) , giving its approximately 129 million enrolled members new ways to stay—and be rewarded—around the world. From sprawling villas and secluded retreats to stylish condos and outdoor adventures, members can now earn and redeem points at hundreds of professionally managed homes and other distinctive stays, with more homes on the way.


Available today at[WyndhamRewards.com/HomesandHavens](https://wyndhamrewards.com/HomesandHavens) , Homes & Havens arrives amid continued demand for vacation rentals, particularly for trips where family and friends want more room to gather and reconnect. With spacious homes suited for everything from family reunions to milestone celebrations, the platform gives Wyndham Rewards members even more ways to make the most of their time together. According to recent research from[Phocuswright](https://www.phocuswright.com/Travel-Research/Research-Updates/2026/shortterm-rentals-enter-a-new-phase-of-scrutiny-and-structural-growth) , approximately 30% of U.S. leisure travelers stayed in a short-term rental on their most recent trip.


---


**"No two trips are the same, and the best rewards programs should reflect that. Whether it's a beachfront villa for a family reunion, a mountain retreat for a weekend with friends or just a quick getaway to one of our thousands of hotels, Wyndham Rewards is committed to giving members more ways to earn and redeem on the travel experiences that matter most to them. Homes & Havens is one more step in creating a fully immersive travel rewards experience, one designed to meet members wherever their journey takes them."**


- Michael Shiwdin, GVP, Integrated Marketing, Loyalty and Digital, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts


---


**From Everyday Getaways to Once-in-a-Lifetime Escapes**
Homes & Havens launches with nearly 800 professionally managed vacation homes and villas across the U.S., Caribbean, Mexico and Europe, with hundreds of additional accommodations—including cabins, yurts and tiny homes—expected to join in the coming months. Together, they offer something for nearly every kind of getaway, from spontaneous weekends away to bucket-list escapes.


Think poolside weekends in the Florida Keys, ski trips in the Rockies, coastal escapes along the Carolinas, private villas in St. Barts and cliffside retreats overlooking the Mediterranean. Depending on the stay, members can find everything from the space and convenience of a home-away-from-home to elevated escapes offering private pools, stunning views and plenty of room to gather, unwind and make the most of their time away.


The platform is made possible through newly formed relationships between Wyndham and a select group of independent property management and hospitality partners, such as[Brightwild](https://www.brightwild.com/) ,[Simpson Travel](https://www.simpsontravel.com/) ,[StayTerra](https://stayterravaca.com/) and[Thousand Trails](https://thousandtrails.com/) .


**Earn and Redeem from Day One**
Homes & Havens properties are available to book online beginning today, with select villas requiring an online reservation request followed by outreach from a reservation specialist. Wyndham Rewards members earn 5 points per U.S. dollar spent on qualified bookings, while qualified nights also count toward unlocking their next Member Level, Wyndham's version of status.


In addition to earning points, members can redeem points for stays using a simple redemption structure similar to the program's hotels. Redemptions currently start at 15,000 points per bedroom, per night, with additional tiers at 30,000 and 45,000 points. A 5,000-point tier is expected to become available as the collection expands. Redemptions can be booked by contacting Wyndham Rewards Member Services at least 60 days in advance and cover the base rate only, excluding taxes, cleaning fees and other mandatory charges. The applicable points tier varies based on the nightly rate per bedroom. While most properties are expected to be available for redemption, not all properties will qualify.


The launch of Homes & Havens builds on the continued evolution of Wyndham Rewards, joining program additions like[Wyndham Rewards Insider](https://www.wyndhamrewardsinsider.com/) , a refreshed portfolio of[Wyndham Rewards Earner® credit cards](https://www.wyndhamrewardscreditcard.com/) and[Wyndham Rewards Experiences](https://wyndhamrewardsexperiences.wyndhamrewards.com/) , which gives members access to can't-miss experiences and unforgettable events across live sports, music, festivals and more. Together, these enhancements are creating a more connected travel rewards experience, giving members more ways to earn, redeem and get rewarded across more of their journey.


To learn more about Homes & Havens or make a reservation, visit[WyndhamRewards.com/HomesandHavens](https://wyndhamrewards.com/HomesandHavens) .

**About Wyndham Rewards**
Part of[Wyndham Hotels & Resorts](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/) (NYSE:[WH](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/wyndham-rewards-ranked-1-by-usa-today-readers-for-ninth-consecutive-year-302844059.html#financial-modal) ),[Wyndham Rewards](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards) is the #1 hotel rewards program as named by both USA TODAY and US News & World Report. With approximately 129 million enrolled members worldwide, members earn a guaranteed 1,000 points with every qualified stay and can redeem for free nights at thousands of hotels, vacation club resorts and vacation rentals globally starting at just 5,000 points. In addition, through[Wyndham Rewards Experiences](https://wyndhamrewardsexperiences.wyndhamrewards.com/) , members can use points to bid on unforgettable experiences and live events while[Wyndham Rewards Insider](https://www.wyndhamrewardsinsider.com/) —a first of its kind travel subscription—offers exclusive savings and perks beyond just hotels, including on flights, cruises, car rentals and more. Join Wyndham Rewards for free at[WyndhamRewards.com](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards) . You can also like and follow us on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/wyndhamrewards) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/wyndhamrewards) and[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@wyndhamrewards) .


**About Wyndham Hotels & Resorts**
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts (NYSE: WH) is one of the world's largest hotel franchising companies with approximately 8,500 hotels across approximately 100 countries on six continents. Through its network of over 877,000 franchised and affiliated rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the economy and midscale segments of the lodging industry. The Company operates a portfolio of 25 hotel brands, including Super 8®, Days Inn®, Ramada®, Microtel®, La Quinta®, Baymont®, Wingate®, AmericInn®, ECHO Suites®, Registry Collection Hotels®, Trademark Collection® and Wyndham®. The Company's award-winning Wyndham Rewards loyalty program offers approximately 129 million enrolled members the opportunity to redeem points at thousands of hotels, vacation club resorts and vacation rentals globally. For more information, visit[www.wyndhamhotels.com](http://www.wyndhamhotels.com/) .
